The story behind Ashabi

A home for African imagination.

Ashabi is being built as a curated home for African comics, graphic novels, illustrated stories, and serialized fiction. A place to discover new voices, follow unfolding worlds, and return to the stories you love.

Stories come first.

Our starting point is simple: make it easy to find something worth reading. From a first chapter to a favourite creator, the experience should keep the work at its heart.

A first look at what is taking shape.

This preview introduces the visual direction and concept collection. The artwork and titles are sample material. They do not represent published books, live creator partnerships, or a catalogue currently open for reading.
